rawContent: As a parent, I need to know what the presidential candidates' plan is to cut #climate pollution & ensure our kids can breathe clean air. Chris Wallace of @FoxNewsSunday: Ask the climate question! #momswantanswers #momsarewatching #ClimateAction #debates2020

.@FoxNewsSunday’s Chris Wallace announced topics for the first #PresidentialDebate, and the #ClimateCrisis wasn’t included. This is unacceptable.  #AskAboutClimate. #Debates2020 #MomsAreWatching @CleanAirMoms

 It would be irresponsible NOT to ask.
